usedFor: Shopify takes orders and TeamWave tracks deals, so “New Order” can feed “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Create Deal” in TeamWave
bestTemplate.why: Each new order lands in TeamWave as a deal, so the sales side sees it.

watchOut: “Create Deal” starts a new deal for every order, so repeat buyers get a deal each time.
